20K SIP with 10% step-up for 10 years - by year 10 the monthly SIP becomes ~47K.

title: Should You Stop Your SIP When the Market Falls? | NKBS
text:
Bilkul sahi sawaal hai! Jab 3 saal tak returns negative dikhte hain, toh doubt hona swabhavik hai. Lekin SIP ka asli maqsad market ke falls (downside) ka fayda uthana hota hai.

Jab market neeche jaati hai, toh aapko same SIP amount mein zyada fund units milte hain (jinhe Rupee Cost Averaging kehte hain). Jab market wapas recover karti hai, tab inhi saste daam par kharide hue extra units par sabse behtareen compounding aur returns bante hain.

Agar aapka financial goal abhi door hai aur fund ke fundamentals sahi hain, toh market fall mein SIP continue rakhna hi long-term wealth creation ke liye sabse samajhdari bhara logic hota hai.

Aap apne fund ki performance aur suitability dekh kar aage ka decision le sakte hain!

title: Should You Stop Your SIP When the Market Falls? | NKBS
text:
You can add a lump sum to an existing SIP fund on market dip days!

Buying on dips lowers your average purchase cost by acquiring more units at a cheaper NAV, which can boost long-term returns. However, predicting short-term market movements is difficult, and the key is ensuring the additional lump sum doesn't disrupt your overall asset allocation or emergency reserves.

If you have idle cash set aside for tactical top-ups, doing so on sharp market dips is a reasonable strategy!
